axes_culturels.description: The expression of personal identity and the construction of relationships in English-speaking societies.
Intergenerational relationships, transmission, conflicts and solidarity between generations in the English-speaking world.
exemples_objets_etude: Generational conflicts (baby boomers vs Gen Z)
Ageing and the place of elders

axes_culturels.description: How the past (historical, memorial, heritage) influences and sheds light on the present in English-speaking societies.
exemples_objets_etude: Civil rights movements and their legacy

axes_culturels.description: Major contemporary challenges and transitions (ecological, technological, societal) facing English-speaking societies.
exemples_objets_etude: Urbanisation and new forms of community living

axes_culturels.description: Artistic, literary and cultural creation as a means of expression and transformation in the English-speaking world.
exemples_objets_etude: Music and cultural movements (hip-hop, punk, grime)

axes_culturels.description: Study of Commonwealth countries: cultural diversity, historical ties, contemporary issues. Compulsory axis opening up to the diversity of the English-speaking world beyond the UK and the USA.

contraintes.note: 5 out of 6 axes must be covered during the year, including axis 6 (The Commonwealth) which is compulsory.

comprehension_orale.descripteur: Understand the main points of elaborate oral messages (conversations, radio/TV broadcasts, presentations) on familiar or personal-interest topics.

comprehension_ecrite.descripteur: Understand texts written in everyday language on topics related to daily life, current affairs or the field of study.

expression_orale.descripteur: Express oneself clearly on familiar topics, recount an event, describe a hope, briefly give reasons and explanations.

expression_ecrite.descripteur: Write a simple, coherent text on familiar topics, personal letters describing experiences and impressions.

interaction.descripteur: Handle most everyday situations, take part in unprepared conversation on familiar topics.

mediation.descripteur: Rephrase, explain or summarise a text or statement for a third party, facilitate intercultural understanding.

grammaire: Present simple and present continuous (revision and deepening)
Present perfect simple (for, since, already, yet, just)
Future (will, be going to, present continuous as future)
Modals (can, could, must, should, may, might)
Relative clauses (who, which, that, whose, where)
Reported speech (said that, told me that)
Conditional types 1 and 2 (if + present / will; if + past / would)
